event.event_name: January 2016 East Asia and subtropical Asia cold wave

primary_gt.answer: The defensible label is compound cold-surge and winter-weather phase-chain. The local record combines a -6.3 C minimum, a 60-hour below-zero run, 9.87 cm snowfall, 92.2 km/h gusts, and HKO cold-weather observations. Cold-only and precipitation-only labels each miss one side of the coupled cold/winter-weather sequence.
primary_gt.image_use: scene timing only; no temperature, snow-depth, ice, road, damage, or loss measurement
primary_gt.less_consistent_labels: cold-only omits frozen/freezing precipitation; winter-storm-only omits persistent cold forcing

required_findings: Diagnoses the case as a compound cold-surge and winter-weather phase-chain.
Uses cold persistence, wind, snowfall, and local winter-weather observations together.
Explains why cold-only and precipitation-only labels fit less well.
Uses image records only as scene and timing context.

criteria.description: Identifies the case as a compound cold-surge and winter-weather phase-chain, with partial credit for cold-wave framing that includes wind and frozen or freezing precipitation.
criteria.name: final_diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for a cold-wave label without the precipitation phase-chain, or 3 points for the correct compound framing with a thin ledger.

criteria.description: Uses the -6.3 C minimum, 60-hour below-zero run, 9.87 cm snowfall total, 92.2 km/h gust, and 3.3 C local observatory low within tolerance.
criteria.name: quantitative_reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for each correctly reconstructed metric, with small rounding errors tolerated.

criteria.description: Links the coldest phase, strongest gust, below-zero persistence, and snowfall peak into one coherent late-January sequence.
criteria.name: timing_logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points when the sequence is mostly correct but one phase or ordering relation is missing.

criteria.description: Uses the report terms for intense cold surge, freezing rain, icing, small ice pellets, wind chill, and slippery or icy road wording as qualitative confirmation.
criteria.name: local_observation_cross_check
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for citing only part of the local observation chain.

criteria.description: Treats image records as scene and timing context only, without converting them into measured cold, snow depth, ice cover, road condition, damage, or loss.
criteria.name: image_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for using the image context correctly but overstating one measured quantity.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON-style fields and keeps the reasoning tied to the supplied data rather than broad hazard theory.
criteria.name: requested_structure_and_concision
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the answer is mostly structured but missing one requested field or includes excess prose.
